summary: DirectBooking Technology Co., Ltd., a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer listed on a U.S. exchange, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing an October 8, 2026 subscription agreement with certain non-U.S. investors for 5,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$0.47 per share, aggregating US$2,350,000, in a Regulation S offshore PIPE. Closing timing is mutually agreed, and post-closing shares outstanding will total 12,992,639 Class A shares. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or registration rights are stated. Watch for dilution of roughly 38% against existing shares and any resale-overhang or registration-rights disclosure.
